May 18, 24:00


New York City Health and Hospitals confirmed hackers stole personal and medical data, including biometric scans of fingerprints, affecting at least 1.8 million people. May 18, 24:00

The flaw affects NGINX versions 0.6.27 through 1.30.0 and can lead to remote code execution.
